qa_pairs.question: What information does the graph on the left provide concerning local disk activity?
qa_pairs.answer: The graph on the left shows the evolution of the number of input/output operations per second (IOPS) performed on the local disk, over time.

qa_pairs.question: What does the graph on the right illustrate regarding local disk usage?
qa_pairs.answer: The graph on the right shows the evolution of the bandwidth used on the local disk over time, which represents the amount of data read or written per second.
